english.meaning: physical edge of a steep place
english.note: Use this specifically for the edge of a cliff, precipice, or other steep place.

exampleSentences.english: We stopped when we reached the brink of the cliff.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋行到懸崖嘅崖邊就停低。
